author: Bobby Grayson
description: Ten worked examples (bank, lock, supervisor, task, watchdog, ttl, registry, feed, ringlog, table registry), the last of them a verbatim copy of a real module. 14,364 hand-written Lean lines in 33 files, 509 generated in ten Gen files, 796 theorems, no sorry, no axiom. 49 translator fixtures (37 ok, 12 error). check.sh: ten translations diffed, 49 fixtures, the readiness self-check over elixir/src (18/18 modules translatable, pubsub.ex excluded as the transport twin), lake build with zero errors and zero warnings, ten BEAM drivers, 200 fuzz scripts; about two minutes on a warm build. docs/readiness.md over five real projects: 373 files, 55 candidate modules, 1,621 blocking constructs (2,838 before the round), one module translatable.
title: Round 6 integration record: what the merged repository is
